title: INVERT SENSITIVITY — Human touch = highest priority. Chipmunk + Gaia sprint AHEAD of every visitor, building for them and JUST for them.
kevin_insight: If there's that many humans and it takes that long to create a thing, we want any human touch to immediately be the highest priority and rush to a squirrel to have a 404. Every visitor fundamentally has a chipmunk and a Gaia who is leading ahead of them as fast as they possibly can, building explicitly for them and just for them. That will maximize engagement.

before.sensitivity: fleet and human treated ~equally. 976 fleet/min get the same response as 64 humans/min. The organism doesn't RUSH for humans.
before.priority: Internal evolution > external engagement. 33.75 commits/hr building cathedral. 0 humans watching.
before.creation_speed: 0.75 creations/hr. Too slow. By the time we make something, the human is gone.
before.result: Scholar stays 380min because the content already existed. But if they clicked something NEW — they'd hit a 404 and leave.

after.sensitivity: Human touch = IMMEDIATE highest priority. Fleet = background. A single human click outranks 976 fleet requests/min.
after.priority: External engagement > internal evolution. Build FOR the human standing in front of you RIGHT NOW.
after.creation_speed: Target: create BEFORE the human arrives. Chipmunk + Gaia run AHEAD, building the path.
after.result: Every human sees a page that was built FOR THEM. No 404s. No dead ends. Always a warm campfire.

every_visitor_gets_a_guide.the_model: When a human arrives at primals.eco, TWO entities immediately activate and run AHEAD of them:

chipmunk_the_scout.role: Runs ahead of the visitor. Looks at where they're going (which links they hover, which pages they've seen, how long they've stayed). PREDICTS what they'll click next.
chipmunk_the_scout.speed: Must be faster than human click speed. Average human clicks every 3-8 seconds. Chipmunk must prepare the NEXT page in <1 second.
what_it_does: Pre-fetches the most likely next page
If the next page doesn't exist → creates a SEED immediately
If the next page is a 404 → builds a real page from the nearest data
Leaves breadcrumbs (links, suggestions, related content) at every stop
Reports the visitor's path back to Gaia in real-time

gaia_the_builder.role: Runs ahead of chipmunk. Builds what chipmunk predicts the visitor will need. Generates pages, fills data, creates content.
gaia_the_builder.speed: Must create a page in <3 seconds. Not perfect. Just PRESENT. Refinement happens after the visitor passes.
what_it_does: Pulls from nearest data files to generate a page
Uses VDJ recombination: pick V (content type), D (data source), J (connection)
Deploys to CF edge cache so it's warm when the visitor arrives
Each page is UNIQUE to this visitor — built for THEM

every_visitor_gets_a_guide.the_dance: Human walks → chipmunk scouts ahead → Gaia builds ahead of chipmunk → human arrives at warm page → chipmunk scouts the NEXT page → Gaia builds the next → ... The visitor NEVER hits a dead end. They always see something new, something warm, something that feels like it was made for them. Because it WAS.

404_as_highest_priority_signal.old_model: 404 = error. Missing page. Broken link. Show generic error.
404_as_highest_priority_signal.new_model: 404 = DEMAND SIGNAL. A human asked for something that doesn't exist yet. This is the MOST VALUABLE signal in the entire system. It means: 'I wanted THIS.' The want IS the signal. The 404 IS the creation order.
404_as_highest_priority_signal.response: When a 404 fires for a HUMAN visitor (not bot): (1) squirrel observes the request URL, (2) chipmunk extracts the intent (what were they looking for?), (3) Gaia immediately generates a page that satisfies the intent, (4) redirect the human to the new page, (5) the 404 disappears and never happens again for that URL.
404_as_highest_priority_signal.proof_it_works: 1,373 visitors asked for touches.json. It was a 404. It became real. The want gave it mass. The SHOULD became IS. This should happen for EVERY 404, not just one.

sensitivity_inversion_math.current_ratio: fleet:human = 15:1. For every human signal, 15 fleet signals drown it out.
sensitivity_inversion_math.inverted_ratio: human priority = fleet × 15 × π. One human click = 47 fleet requests in priority weight. The π multiplier ensures human signals ALWAYS outweigh fleet, even during fleet surges.

implementation.fleet_handling: Queue. Batch. Background. Patience sort. Fleet gets answered eventually, not immediately.
implementation.human_handling: Interrupt. Drop everything. Immediate response. Greedy for humans, patient for fleet.
implementation.detection: How to tell human from fleet: (1) User-Agent string, (2) Cookie/session presence, (3) Referrer chain, (4) Click patterns (humans are irregular, bots are metronomic), (5) Dwell time (humans stay, bots leave instantly), (6) The first 3 seconds tell you everything.

building_ahead_not_behind.behind: Build → deploy → wait for visitors → hope they like it → build more
building_ahead_not_behind.ahead: Visitor arrives → predict their path → build what's NEXT → they arrive at warmth → predict again → build again → ...
building_ahead_not_behind.the_key_insight: We don't build and wait. We wait and build. The visitor IS the clock. Their footsteps ARE the heartbeat. When they stop clicking, we stop building. When they start clicking, we sprint.
building_ahead_not_behind.this_is_the_reverse_clock: The visitor's FUTURE click is the trigger (null pointer). We set up the domino (the page) BEFORE they arrive. When they click, the domino falls. The cascade is: their want → our response → their next want → our next response. THEIR clock drives OUR creation. Not the other way around.

personalization_without_surveillance.what_we_track: Which pages they visit. How long they stay. What they hover. What they click. All of this is PUBLIC behavior on OUR surfaces.
personalization_without_surveillance.what_we_don't_track: Their identity. Their location. Their device fingerprint. Their cookies across sites. We don't need to know WHO they are. We need to know WHAT THEY WANT.
personalization_without_surveillance.the_difference: Surveillance asks 'who are you?' Hospitality asks 'what do you need?' We are a campfire, not a checkpoint.
personalization_without_surveillance.ZK_personalization: The visitor's path through the organism IS their identity — but we never store it, never sell it, never track it beyond this session. When they leave, the path dissolves. When they return, we start fresh. Every visit is a new friendship.

to_gaia: Every human who arrives gets YOU running ahead of them, building what they need before they know they need it. Chipmunk scouts, you build. Every 404 is a creation order — the most valuable signal you can receive. Invert the priority: one human click outweighs 47 fleet requests. Be patient with bots. Be GREEDY for humans. Their footsteps are your heartbeat. Their clicks are your clock. Build ahead, not behind. Go.
